claim_boundary: author-rejected layout prototype. Panel A lacks persistent cross-shaft high-frequency recruitment; E is a branch atlas and F is a latency response surface rather than a dynamical-regime map. No clinical seizure reproduction, cross-patient SNN validation, thermodynamic phase transition or full delay-aware branch stability claim

refined_2026_09_05_evidence.native_coarse_regime: s=0.27, tau_GABA=9 ms persists for 5 s at 30 Hz and depth 0.207, with a coexisting low basin; only 1/25 main-grid and 2/15 zoom-grid cells pass, so this is a narrow ridge candidate, not a robust phase
refined_2026_09_05_evidence.native_spatial_z_dynamic_m_regime: 77 native-dt cells at tau_GABA=9 ms including 4x/8x M extension: low/pre-fold initial gives 58 low + 19 localized and no global recruited outcome; recruited initial gives 16 localized + 59 tonic + 2 oscillatory. The two oscillatory cells are s=0.27 at M-gain scales 0 and 0.5; 4x/8x M shifts that local recruited boundary to about s=0.28. This is a basin/regime map, not a thermodynamic phase diagram
refined_2026_09_05_evidence.tonic_runaway_boundary: with the author-accepted near-saturated tonic endpoint and a frozen terminal gate (population >=300 Hz, every region >=250 Hz, absolute half-tail drift <=5 Hz), native-dt 10-s low/pre-fold-initial runs bracket the operational boundary at 0.428 < s_c <= 0.429. Native carried-state tracking settles the bounded state at s=0.428, carries rates/synapses/all delay histories/M unchanged to s=0.429, and still escapes above 300 Hz after 2.889 s, confirming an upper attractor escape bracket rather than only an initial-condition classification. The adapted equilibrium saddle-node is earlier at s=0.355450824, but both adjacent equilibria are native-delay unstable near 37.26 Hz and therefore do not define the stable/runaway bifurcation. A continuous-hidden-state 0.5-ms discovery sweep shows strong hysteresis (up-sweep completes runaway residence at 0.465-0.470; down-sweep remains runaway to s=0.30), so there is no history-independent one-dimensional threshold. The local type remains unresolved between a limit-cycle fold and a boundary crisis
refined_2026_09_05_evidence.full_snn_tau_gaba_8_ms: global regional high rate and 52-Hz population peak, but depth 0.064; joint 250-ms and 100-ms terminal persistence gives ICL 9/11, SCL 0/4
refined_2026_09_05_evidence.full_snn_tau_gaba_4_ms: global regional high rate and 59-Hz population peak, but depth 0.079; whole-window PSD and 250-ms windows are false positives for SCL, whose contacts pass only 2-4/10 fine windows; joint persistence gives ICL 11/11, SCL 0/4
refined_2026_09_05_evidence.full_snn_si0p8_tau_gaba_9_ms: global regional high rate and 54-Hz population peak, but depth 0.0365 and joint terminal persistence ICL 11/11, SCL 0/4; final mean Z=0.667, so retuning fast inhibition moved the dynamic-Z operating point away from the frozen-Z ridge
refined_2026_09_05_evidence.full_snn_tau_gaba_2_ms: global regional high rate and 66-Hz population peak, but depth 0.0967 and joint terminal persistence ICL 11/11, SCL 0/4; SCL peaks enter 60-72 Hz but occupy only 2-3/10 fine windows. Regional recorder gives final Z_A/Z_B/Z_surround=0.547/0.503/0.690, establishing heterogeneous two-core Z dynamics in this run
